projectDescription: Tcktio is an automated purchasing bot for limited-edition sneakers, streetwear, and rare collectibles that lets users cop drops faster than any human across dozens of supported retail stores.
keyFeatures: Easy-to-use dashboard for managing all workflows in one place
Drop-beating performance with fast, reliable checkout execution
High-scale task execution across simultaneous drops
Automated account generator for supported retail sites
Built-in anti-bot challenge handling (Queue-IT and others)
Real-time SMS and email notification management
Support for 14+ retail sites including Amazon, Fnac, Smyths Toys, and more
